narrativeProgression.description: Nigar Johar expresses her happiness about the symposium, especially because a woman leads it.
She praises Sarah Yamin for her inclusivity in bringing together women from different countries.
She emphasizes the conference's focus on diversity, inclusivity, and its excellent organization.
She stresses the importance of gender equality for sustainable peace and security, calling for more measures and role models.
She shifts to discussing the need for economic empowerment for women and how that ties into peace and security.
She concludes by reflecting on the value of learning from other panelists' experiences to promote women, peace, and security globally.

youtube_description: General (Ret) Nigar Johar (Pakistan Army) was born in a village and wanted to be a doctor and in the Army. She did her schooling from Presentation Convent, MBBS from Army medical college and was commissioned in 1985.  She notes that she was rewarded for her struggles and hard work with a lot of firsts as a woman officer. She is the first female to command any unit in the history of Pakistan Armed Forces and also to command the biggest military hospital of Pakistan. She is the first and only woman to be promoted as Lt General and also to be appointed as surgeon general, doctor, administrator and public health specialist.  She possesses a Master’s in Advance Medical Administration, a Master’s in Public Health, MCPS in Family Medicine, FRCP UK Edin(hon) and FCPS in community medicine.  She serves as a national instructor for hospital preparedness for emergency remaining at the forefront of the response to COVID-19 and unprecedented floods in recent years.  She has been awarded multiple medals and honors, is  appreciated at all levels and considered an inspiring role model.
